'''Hops''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Hops Starter]] after 11 days and continues to produce every day after maturity.

Hops can be put into a [[Keg]] to make [[Pale Ale]].

==Stages==
You cannot walk through Hops at any stage of growth.  You can walk through dead Hops plants.

==Bundles==
Five Hops are one of the options in the {{Bundle|Wild Medicine||y}}.

==Recipes==
Hops is not used in any recipes.

==Artisan Goods==
Hops may be placed in a [[Keg]] to produce [[Pale Ale]].  Pale Ale may be aged in [[Cask]]s to increase its quality.

==Tailoring==
Hops is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a dyeable {{Name|Shirt159|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt and Belt|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Tips==
*Hops give the 2nd best experience for leveling up [[Farming]] skill in a single season, giving 102 to 126 points, depending on speed growth fertilizers. (Mature [[Ancient Fruit]] gives the most farming XP.)
*Selling [[Hops Starter]] made from the [[Seed Maker]] can be more profitable than selling the Hops directly, and also potentially generates [[Ancient Seeds]]. Pale Ale and Pickled Hops are more profitable, but the Seed Maker takes only 20 in-game minutes.
